#e<Artifact Hunt Contest Announcement>
#nGreetings from the Relic Excavation Association! We hope that you will join us for some healthy, educational competition in our Artifact Hunt Contest. You will receive an Artifact Hunt score when you obtain #b#t2430010#s#k from monsters. Once your Artifact Hunt score reaches #b1000#k or more for a single day, you will be cleared to participate in the Artifact Hunt Contest proper, and will receive a gift everyday.#r
  #t2430010#s can only be found by players who view the Artifact Hunt Contest announcement daily.
  By studying the announcement carefully, you may be able to find Mystical Artifacts hidden inside the #t2430010#s.
#kWe look forward to a big turnout for this contest! Good luck!

- #eShuang#n, Relic Excavation Association -
